name: com.hienadev.devtools
description: Editor tools for every project: Build All (Windows + Web builds in one click, zipped, with a build report and itch.io publishing), Perf Doctor (a plain-language profiler), Audio Trimmer (cut, fade and loop sounds), Game view screenshots and an Itch Page Kit (cover, screenshots, banner, GIF maker) a Web Size Tester, a Play toolbar, scene switcher, jam timer, Hierarchy notes/TODO and icons, folder colours, Find References, Bulk Rename, a Changelog, Missing Scripts, selection history and Favourites.
